title: Platform Onboard 30/60/90 Playbook — pilot enablement (WIP)
content:
Purpose and scope:
- One-pager slide deck to arm platform/sales engineers for fast pilot wins with Platform teams (on-prem/VPC/Dedicated).
- Audience: platform eng/infra architects, solution engineers, AE technical leads.
- Outcome: 30/60/90 day pilot blueprint + objection handling + canary/fallback checklist so pilots convert to Reserved/Dedicated conversations.

Slide 1: Title + TL;DR
- Title: Platform Onboard 30/60/90 Playbook — Pilot Enablement (WIP)
- TL;DR bullets: agree pilot scope in week 0; deploy lightweight VPC connector + sample workload in 2 weeks; validate SLOs and cost model in 30–60 days; propose reserved commitment after 90d.
- Quick wins: basic latency demo, cost-per-req calc, simple failover demo to hosted API.

Slide 2: Why this matters to Platform teams
- Problem: inconsistent inference SLAs across teams, ops overhead, unpredictable unit costs.
- Value props that resonate with platform teams: consistent runtime, canary routing, auditable network controls, KMS integration.
- Elevator: ship an internal LLM endpoint with enterprise controls in <2 weeks for discovery workloads.

Slide 3: Pilot hypothesis + success metrics (must be specific)
- Hypothesis: Redwood Dedicated can provide equivalent-or-better p95 latency at <=X% unit cost vs current hosted/DIY.
- Primary metrics (convert criteria): p95 latency <= target_ms (customer-provided), throughput sustained for 60m, per-token cost <= threshold, no P0 incidents in 30d.
- Secondary metrics: developer time-to-integration, SSO/KMS verified, audit logs present.

Slide 4: 30/60/90 timeline (practical tasks)
- Day 0–7: Kickoff, NDA + SOW, access + environment provisioning checklist. (owner: SE/solutions)
- Day 7–21: Quick integration + sample workload run. Setup: VPC peering or private link, credential exchange, test corpus. Run smoke test for latency, throughput. (owner: infra eng + customer eng)
- Day 21–45: Workload stabilization. Introduce canary routing and fallback to hosted model. Tune batching/quant params; run cost-sensitivity matrix. (owner: platform eng + prod)
- Day 45–90: Scale validation and handoff. Run load ramp to production-like concurrency, finalize cost model and Reserved recommendation, prepare SLA docs. (owner: AE + Solutions + Customer Success)

Slide 5: Integration checklist (tech skinny) — copyable into tickets
- Networking: CIDR ranges, egress rules, proxy whitelisting, certs.
- Auth: SSO/OAuth or API keys, KMS/HSM integration, token rotation cadence.
- Data handling: model input sanitize, retention policy, logging endpoints.
- Runtime: model variant (fp16/4-bit), batch settings, KV cache config, quant profile.
- Observability: token-level cost, request traces, error rate dashboards.
- Canary controls: route % config, fallback model mapping.

Slide 6: Demo playbook (2-minute tech demo)
- Demo flow: 1) baseline request to hosted model (show latency/cost), 2) switch route to Dedicated pilot (show lower p95 with batch caching), 3) trigger a controlled overload -> show automatic fallback to hosted and preserved SLA.
- Data prep: 50 representative queries, 10 concurrent clients, token cap per request.
- What to capture: p50/p95, tokens emitted, CPU/GPU metrics, fallback events.

Slide 7: Pricing & quick math (sales-ready snippets)
- How to present: show unit economics for three profiles — discovery (low QPS), growth (bursting), production (consistent high QPS).
- Example calc (copyable): If pilot uses 100k tokens/day, at hosted pricing = $X, Dedicated amortized = $Y; show break-even point at N days and Reserved plan win threshold.
- Notes: call out add-on costs (obs retention, private-control-plane fees).

Slide 8: Common procurement & security objections + scripts
- Objection: "We need on-prem air-gapped option." Script: "We have a private deployment package and checklist — minimal offline install takes ~X engineer-days; we’ll surface the compliance pack and previous customer references."
- Objection: "How do we guarantee latency under load?" Script: "We run model-level profiles, set capacity targets, and use canary routing during ramp; here’s a 30/60/90 we use to validate."
- Objection: "We are locked into a cloud vendor." Script: "We support private link/VPC peering and hybrid routing so you can start with existing infra and later migrate to Reserved if it fits economics."

Slide 9: Triage flow for pilot incidents (playbook)
- First 15 minutes: Detect via alert -> switch to fallback routing (hosted). Notify customer + capture traces.
- 15–60 minutes: Fluent blame — is it model saturation, network, or infra? Attach logs to ticket; enable increased batch size if safe.
- Post-incident: RCA + corrective plan + SLO adjustments.

Slide 10: Handoff & conversion checkpoints
- Conversion trigger: 90d review shows p95 met and predictable unit cost; customer ready to commit to Reserved or Dedicated.
- Handoff artifacts: SLO report, cost model, runbook, signed security/compliance docs, rollout plan.
- Ask: who will be the internal champion? Name + function required before conversion call.

Slide 11: Playbook one-pager for AE/SE (copy-paste)
- 3 lines to win the exec: predictability, auditable security controls, economics.
- 2-minute demo steps (see slide 6).
- 5 min integration checklist (see slide 5) — use as ticket template.
- Call to action: Schedule tech kickoff within 7 days of LOI.

Slide 12: Open questions / risk register (notes to self)
- Unknowns: customer sequences longer than our training profile -> need longer context benchmark.
- Risk: procurement cycle >90 days — fallback: smaller POC + exec sponsor.
- Engineering ask: faster private install script and Terraform module for vpc-peering.

Appendix A: Sample email templates
- Kickoff invite, pilot completion summary, conversion ask + pricing snapshot. (include copyable blocks)

Appendix B: Short checklist for Solutions Engineers (day-by-day)
- Day 0: send network spec, set up tracking doc, create Confluence pilot page.
- Week 1: validate smoke tests, run latency harness, confirm log ingestion.
- Week 2–4: performance tuning, report back to AE with cost/baseline.

Notes to self / TODOs (raw)
- Need a 1-click deck variant with only 6 slides for execs.
- Get Petra from infra to finalize private-install hours estimate.
- Add a small table with realistic host vs dedicated per-token numbers for commonly used models (gpt-like, code models) — ask applied-ml for numbers.
- Collect two customer references (anonymized) for handoff packet.

Scratch / shorthand logs used in meetings:
- "If we can hit p95 120ms for search workload, platform team buys Reserved."
- "Make sure SE has the 'fallback demo' snippet in sandbox before meeting."
- "Ask legal for example DPA & SOC checklist — keep in handoff folder."

End of draft.

---
Metadata note: this is a working slide-deck draft intended to be iterated in Sprint planning with SEs and Solutions; copy/paste pieces into AE battlecards or create a trimmed deck for executive sponsor.
